carrier.description: Plain alias for provider; defaults to the platform's managed carrier.

country.description: ISO country code or country name.

number_type.description: local, national, mobile, toll_free, shared_cost, or UIFN.

OutboundCall.description: recipient_type is optional and recorded, never enforced. Destination country is authorized against the org's approved risk envelope (authorize_outbound), not a fixed platform allowlist. Blocked categories mirror carrier acceptable-use policy; debt collection is not a blocked category -- payment_reminder (first-party or third-party) is permitted with per-call authorization, subject to per-customer onboarding approval and the acceptable-use policy.

call_context.description: Small bounded, non-secret facts valid at call start. Never put endpoint credentials, current balances, or mutable case history here.

country.description: Destination country. Authorized per-organization by the approved risk envelope.

external_reference.description: Customer-owned stable case/reference ID. OpenPhonex stores it but does not interpret it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional body alternative to the Idempotency-Key header. Retries must reuse the same value with the same request.

purpose.description: Required, free-form outbound purpose declaration -- a non-empty purpose is the compliance paper trail; a novel purpose token is never refused for being novel. Documented catalog (pick one or send your own token): appointment, booking_confirmation, callback_requested, delivery_notification, ops_alert, other, payment_reminder, personal_errand, reservation, status_check, support.

recipient_type.description: Optional, never enforced or required -- outbound is not restricted to business recipients. Persisted verbatim on the call row if sent; SMS has no recipient_type column, so it is accepted but not stored there.

available_provider_number_id.description: Provider available-number identifier captured before ordering (the carrier's available_dids.id).

price_snapshot.description: Captured quote used for audit/customer display; the carrier API remains authoritative when quote is fetched.

provider_order_id.description: Provider order identifier returned after order execution.

name.description: Customer-facing label, e.g. My phone server.

password_reference.description: Reference to an external secret; plaintext passwords are not returned.

server_address.description: Hostname or public IP of the customer's phone server.

schema.description: When enabled: an object schema with 1-24 scalar properties (string, number, integer, or boolean), optional string enums, and no additional properties.

result.description: Schema-validated advisory scalar output. Values can be null when unavailable.

live_media.description: Explicitly request the live media worker path.

SmsMessage.description: recipient_type is optional and never enforced; there is no recipient_type column on the SMS row, so it is accepted but not persisted. Blocked categories mirror carrier acceptable-use policy; debt collection is not a blocked category -- payment_reminder (first-party or third-party) is permitted with per-call authorization, subject to per-customer onboarding approval and the acceptable-use policy.

purpose.description: Required, free-form outbound purpose declaration -- a non-empty purpose is the compliance paper trail; a novel purpose token is never refused for being novel. recipient_type.description: Optional, never enforced or required -- outbound is not restricted to business recipients. Persisted verbatim on the call row if sent; SMS has no recipient_type column, so it is accepted but not stored there.

get.description: Returns one tenant-bound Agents DTO for SSR. It includes resolved static voice-stack display data, which components the customer actually configured (as opposed to the catalog defaults the resolved stack fills in), an inbound-admission verdict per agent, attached number routing, exact UTC-day activity, and wallet currency without provider or catalog API calls, verification, invoice, SMS, or webhook service reads. The admission verdict is a pure read of workspace state: it lists the reasons the inbound call path would refuse a call, the conditions it could not evaluate before a call exists, and a readiness of blocked or indeterminate — never ready, because the gates that need the agent's number are not run here. A line-scoped readiness is reported by the Overview aggregate's primary_line. An agent answered by the customer's own service is judged on the endpoints it needs rather than on the managed stack it does not use.
